svg.title: Install and start OmniRoute, connect an eligible provider with your own account, then configure your tool. Auto routing depends on eligible connections and provider limits.
svg.desc: Animated flow card: three step tiles (Install and start, Connect provider, Use your tool) fade in left to right, a dot travels along the connectors between them in a loop, and the final check pulses.

g.text: Use your own account or API key.

svg.text: auto uses eligible connections; availability and provider limits still apply.
